title: Decision-Centered Abstractions via Orthogonal Estimation of Difference-of-Q Functions
abstract: arXiv:2406.08697v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning enables evaluation and optimization of sequential decisions from historical data, when it is not possible to deploy new policies online due to safety, cost, and other concerns. Big data advances enable rich state information, but may naively include reward- and action- irrelevant dynamics that are ultimately unnecessary for learning optimal actions. We introduce state abstractions that target preservation of the difference-of-Q functions, and we propose to learn these abstractions via causal machine learning of the difference-of-Q function and standard statistical sparse learning. Under a nonparametric additive-rewards model, we characterize when decision-centered abstractions are simpler than the full state space, motivating our estimation procedure. translated_title: 基于Q函数差分正交估计的以决策为中心的状态抽象
translated_abstract: 离线强化学习使得在因安全、成本等因素而无法在线部署新策略的情况下，能够从历史数据中对序列决策进行评估和优化。大数据技术的进步提供了丰富的状态信息，但其中可能天真地包含与奖励和动作无关的动态信息，而这些信息对于学习最优动作最终是不必要的。我们引入了以保留Q函数差分为目标的状态抽象方法，并提出通过Q函数差分的因果机器学习以及标准的统计稀疏学习来学习这些抽象。在非参数加性奖励模型下，我们刻画了以决策为中心的抽象何时比完整状态空间更简洁，这为我们的估计方法提供了理论动机。我们开发了R学习器（R learner，Nie等人2021年、Lewis和Syrgkanis 2021年）的动态泛化版本，用于估计Q函数的差分，针对离散……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出以保留Q函数差分为目标的状态抽象方法，通过因果机器学习与统计稀疏学习实现，并开发了R学习器的动态泛化版本来估计Q函数差分，从而在离线强化学习中构建更简洁的以决策为中心的状态表示。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces decision-centered state abstractions that preserve the difference-of-Q functions, learned through causal machine learning and statistical sparse learning, together with a dynamic generalization of the R learner for estimating Q-function differences in offline reinforcement learning.
